name: raycast-phpipam
title: PhpIPAM
description: Search and browse your phpIPAM instance: addresses, subnets, sections, VLANs and VRFs.
author: frdmn

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search IPAM
commands.description: Search phpIPAM for addresses, subnets, VLANs and VRFs

commands.name: browse-sections
commands.title: Browse Sections
commands.description: Browse phpIPAM sections and drill into their subnets

commands.name: browse-subnets
commands.title: Browse Subnets
commands.description: List and filter all subnets across all sections

commands.name: first-free
commands.title: First Free Address
commands.description: Find and copy the first free IP address of a subnet

preferences.name: phpipamUrl
preferences.title: phpIPAM URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your phpIPAM instance, e.g. https://phpipam.example.com

preferences.name: appId
preferences.title: API App ID
preferences.description: The application ID created in phpIPAM under Administration → API

preferences.name: username
preferences.title: Username
preferences.description: phpIPAM user with API permissions (local user, not SAML). Not needed when an App Code is set.

preferences.name: password
preferences.title: Password
preferences.description: Password of the phpIPAM user. Not needed when an App Code is set.

preferences.name: appCode
preferences.title: API App Code
preferences.description: Only for apps with 'SSL with App code token' security: the App code (from the app's edit dialog in phpIPAM) is used as token instead of username/password. Leave empty for 'SSL with User token' or 'User token'.
preferences.placeholder: Only for 'SSL with App code token' apps

preferences.name: ignoreTlsErrors
preferences.title: Ignore TLS certificate errors
preferences.description: Allow self-signed certificates. Use with caution.
preferences.label: Ignore TLS errors
